title: Pressure-Robust $H(\mathrm{div})$-Conforming HDG Methods for the Steady Stokes Equations with an Application to Tangential Boundary Control
summary: We develop a family of $H(\mathrm{div})$-conforming hybridizable discontinuous Galerkin methods for the steady Stokes equations based on BDM and RT velocity spaces with either discontinuous or continuous hybrid traces. In contrast to our earlier pressure-robust HDG method for tangential boundary control, the present analysis does not require the pressure to belong to $H^1$; instead, the consistency argument only assumes low pressure regularity. The discrete velocities are exactly divergence-free, which yields pressure robustness. For the BDM variants we derive optimal energy-norm estimates…
